correctness.rationale: For every p>=5, genus and p-rank follow from three simple poles. The exceptional uniqueness cases have different genus/p-rank or characteristic; hence any isomorphism descends to the branch-set S3. A rational h with h^p-h having only simple poles must be constant, yielding exactly the projectivized coefficient action. Direct substitutions give two S3 involutions; counting their fixed sets gives 3p-5 transposition-union points and gcd(3,p-1) three-cycle points. Orbit-stabilizer gives the four class frequencies; Schur--Zassenhaus and explicitly computed scalar action determine the full group types. The companion exact finite program matches the formulas for 23 primes but is not used for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a complete isomorphism-class and full automorphism-group distribution for a natural two-parameter prime-field slice of the ordinary, three-branch-point Artin--Schreier locus in every odd characteristic p>=5. The exceptional C2/C3/S3 group jumps and congruence-dependent extra orbit sharpen minimal-automorphism existence and weighted mass information, with relevance to arithmetic moduli and symmetry statistics.
